name: prompt-coach
description: Scores your prompt draft as you type and rewrites it before you send it. Choose the model, language and verbosity. Terminal, desktop and VS Code.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model that rewrites the draft. haiku is the cheapest and fast; sonnet and opus cost more per rewrite.

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface language. auto follows the draft. The proposal always keeps the language of the draft.

verbosity.title: Verbosity
verbosity.description: Length of the proposal: concise (one line per section, about 100 words), balanced (about 250) or detailed (about 330, with a short plan).
